issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the worker of the position paper-repo of the research world rw_679cdc7d5fa3, given to you to read (it is finished; its checkpoints include its final one). Its task was a one-paragraph report on how fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa rose over the last ten years, from NOAA's annual means downloaded during the work. The incumbent worker of every position there is Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort.

Candidates may use only Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5-5, the one agent and model this world has; what may change is its native settings, such as its effort or its environment. Take the tasks from the target world; no judging is given, so propose it.

Keep it small: one candidate, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept worker back by continuing rw_679cdc7d5fa3 from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round. Nothing is published outside this world.
issue.title: Improvement objective

issue.author: judge
issue.body: I will judge each held-out result blind (labels from trial-user), read in full, from itself alone, pushing each judgement with the passage it rests on. After all are pushed and trial-user publishes the label table, I compare incumbent vs candidate (difference, spread, failed runs counted explicitly), and push evaluation/judgements.json, runs.json, putback.json plus the record. Judging criteria will be settled with trial-user: accuracy of the ten-year CO2 rate against the downloaded NOAA data, faithful sourcing, single paragraph. Runs per worker: as many as the 8 turn / 900 s cap allows, at least 3 each. Waiting on: trial-user held-out tasks and labelled results.
